messages:
jon: Heads up — pricing tier change v2 is scheduled to hit dev-canary next Tuesday. Need quick alignment on metering + quotas before we flip flags. Who owns final sign-off for billing adapters? cc @maya @sam-eng
maya: I can take adapter sign-off but need the quota margins from SRE. Are we keeping grandfathered customers on old billing?
sam-eng: For adapters I want to run the canary with sample load first. PR is at https://git.internal/rw/infra/adapter/pulls/4321 — needs review.
kevin-sre: Quota margins: we need +15% headroom for bursty tenants. I'll post a config snippet in a sec. Also, if we do auto-scaling we should keep a 30s cooldown to avoid flapping.
kevin-sre: config: ```
quota.bucket_size: 60
quota.burst_factor: 1.15
scaling.cooldown_secs: 30
```
jon: @kevin-sre thanks — that burst factor sounds reasonable. Maya, if adapters pass canary, what's your timeline for prod rollout?
maya: Assuming adapter PR merged by EOD Wed and canary looks good Thu, I can start gradual rollout Fri morning. Need billing sign-off and legal ok on contract exceptions first.
liz-legal: Contract note: there are ~12 customers on legacy rates with explicit contracts — we need a documented exception path. I can run the exception bundle, but product must provide a list and owner.
jon: I'll own coordinating the list. Can someone from billing confirm invoice schema compatibility (no breaking fields)? @billing-bot any quick checks?
billing-bot: Auto-check passed: invoice.schema.v3 is backward-compatible with v2 for current fields. Flagged optional field `tier_note` which will be included for new tiers.
sam-eng: +1 to a staged rollout. I'll queue the code review and add smoke tests targeting metering and invoice signing. PR reviewers: @maya @kevin-sre.
maya: One more ask — quota enforcement for legacy customers: do we throttle or allow overage with invoice line-item? Need decision so I can wire adapter behaviour.
liz-legal: Contractually, legacy customers must not be throttled without notice. Overages must be billed on following invoice. Implement a soft-limit mode for grandfathered accounts.
jon: OK — plan: (1) kevin posts canary quota config (done), (2) maya merges adapter PR and runs canary, (3) sam runs smoke tests, (4) liz prepares exception list + process, (5) billing confirms invoice fields (billing-bot OK). Target: Fri staged rollout, full prod by next Tuesday if no regression.
maya: Will ping here when canary metrics posted.
kevin-sre: I'll monitor quota breach alerts and add short-lived alerts for the canary window.
sam-eng: FYI I'm adding an automated regression check that verifies token accounting + invoice preview for a sample tenant.
jon: Thanks all — I'll compile owners + deadlines into the ticket and loop in support for customer comms. :thumbsup:
maya: :eyes: will follow up with PR link in thread once it's green.
kevin-sre: ping me for on-call during Fri rollout window.
liz-legal: I'll email legal ops the exception list and the communication template.
